Subject: SI trial fuel grant request — cohort #7

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the intro last week. CloudBridge is kicking off cohort #7 for SIs next month and StartHub is slated to run a 12-week PoC for three of our mutual customers. To reduce friction for the pilots, we typically request a small promotional credit pool (what we call a "fuel grant") routed through the SI so they can subsidize onboarding and early usage.

Scope request: 100k tokens (applied as free credits) split across three pilots, valid 30 days after activation. StartHub will handle usage reporting and share a short success story at the end of the cohort.

Attached is a short term sheet with our standard ask and an onboarding agenda. Can Redwood confirm whether this can be approved under partner credit policy, and what routing / billing events you need from us?

Attachments: si_trial_fuel_grant_term_sheet.pdf (1 page), cohort_onboarding-agenda.docx (1 page)

Cheers,

Thanks Arun — quick read, this looks reasonable and aligns with other SI cofunds we've approved. A couple of clarifying items before I loop in Sales Ops for allocation:

- Confirm the exact token accounting model you want us to apply (generation tokens only vs. generation + context).
- Do you need a single pooled credit object (one code) or three separate allocations per pilot?
- Are any of the pilot customers sensitive (PCI/PHI) that would require Private deployment or an SLA exception?

If you can confirm those, I will put this in for a formal credit allocation and route to Ben for sign-off. Also tagging Kimberly and Steph to prep the usage dashboard template and the short agreement.

Best,

Subject: RE: SI trial fuel grant request — cohort #7 — Ops input

Vivek / team — ops notes below based on the term sheet:

- Recommended allocation: create one pooled credit of 100,000 tokens with three usage buckets (50k / 30k / 20k) to reduce administrative churn. We can tag each pilot in billing metadata.
- Token accounting: Redwood bills on generation + context by default; for subsidized pilots we can apply credits to total token usage but will show pre-credit unit cost in reporting.
- Security: checked the customer list from Arun — none flagged for PCI/PHI. Standard hosted endpoints fine.
- Expiry: term sheet requests 30 days; Ops recommends 60 days to allow ramp.
- Docs: I attached a pre-filled usage_dashboard_template.xlsx and a one-page credit addendum we push to DocuSign (si_trial_fuel_grant_term_sheet.pdf).

If Ben is comfortable with the extended expiry and pooled structure, we can create the credit object this week and send DocuSign to StartHub.

Attachments: usage_dashboard_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), si_trial_fuel_grant_term_sheet.pdf (redlined)

Kimberly Park
Partner Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SI trial fuel grant request — cohort #7 — Approval

Vivek / Kim — approved with conditions:

1) Approve pooled 100k token credit, expiry 60 days from activation.
2) StartHub must sign the one-page addendum and agree to a short case-study clause (they can redact or delay publication for 90 days).
3) Credit must be applied to deal DL-2028-0821-07 and tagged in HubSpot.
4) If aggregate usage exceeds 100k tokens, we will convert overage to a coupon at list rate and notify the SI; commercial terms for any paid conversion must be handled by Sales.

Kimberly — please proceed to create the credit object, generate the DocuSign envelope, and copy me on the envelope. Vivek — once signed, please confirm activation window and schedule a 30-minute kickoff with StartHub / CloudBridge to walk through the usage dashboard.
